prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single isolated toy-shop building reference for image-to-3D, for the children's game Electro-table.
Reference image 1: approved city composition; use ONLY its small lavender toy shop with pink roof in the upper-right corner as architectural and palette reference. Do not reproduce the city.
Reference image 2: bakery; use its tactile molded painted-toy material, softly rounded solid edges, generous cream trim and readable architectural details. Do not copy its oven, chimney, base or empty shop interior.
Create one beautiful compact one-storey lavender toy shop with a low magenta-pink tiled hipped roof, cream cornice and frames, shallow pink-and-cream striped scalloped awning. A large shop display with exactly three chunky recognizable toys: honey-colored teddy bear, colorful ball, small turquoise-and-coral toy train. Toys are static shallow molded relief backed by an opaque dark blue display panel, integrated into the facade, not loose objects or a deep/open interior. Place a narrow cream-framed teal door at street level to the left of the display. Small simple side window. No sign or lettering.
Proportions: broad and low; approximate full outer width 6, full height 4.2, depth 4.4 INCLUDING roof, awning and trims. Keep the roof particularly low so a gameplay bell behind the building remains visible; no dormer, tower, tall emblem or rooftop toys. Whole closed opaque building, not a cutaway. Solid roof continuous across the back.
Composition: single complete object, front three-quarter view showing front and right wall, slightly elevated camera, centered with clear margin; warm off-white seamless studio background, soft neutral daylight, gentle contact shadow. Crisp sculpted details with restrained satin finish, polished premium children's toy look. Cream and lavender walls, rose-magenta roof, teal accents and warm golden toy details. Large simple shapes readable at small game scale, not microdetail.
Constraints: flat bottom at ground level, no base slab, pedestal, plinth, steps, pavement, plants, people, animals, bins, bell, wires or detached props. No text, numbers, logos, watermark, transparent glass, holes through the building, open underside or interior room. One view only, no collage.
mode: built-in image_gen; reference generation, not an edit
status: Reference approved m0223; one Studio GLB created and installed, see toy-shop-3d/release.json
inspection: Single low lavender shop, pink closed-looking roof, shallow striped awning, three recognizable molded toys backed by opaque dark blue display, street-level teal door. No text, separate props, base slab, people or stairs. Hidden roof topology, real dimensions and gameplay visibility cannot be established from PNG.

verification.browser: IAB static HTML reference, Python localhost server
verification.visualInspection: Image visible; responsive single-column at390; bottom conditions and links accessible by scrolling. This is not a game viewport test.
